title: P3 fix round 1: the route classification cache stores one entry per content key (not a single global slot) with per-entry TTL and pruning under the lock, so interleaved tasks of different shapes hit their own entries; [jev.routing] moves next to [jev] in pool.toml (review T-0484)
spec:
Fix round for T-0471 (P3) on task/T-0471 at 5e6e7a5, addressing review T-0484 (two findings). Work only in your own worktree and commit only on your own branch (git branch --show-current must print your task id); never write into another worktree.
1. orchestrator/jev_route.py cache (around line 36, _cache_paths): .orchestrator/runs/jev/route_cache.json holds a dict keyed by the content key (sha1 over spec, acceptance, scope, complexity, task_class) -> {signals, confidence, saved_at, task}; reads and writes under the existing lock; a lookup hits only its own key when saved_at is within [jev.routing].cache_ttl_s; expired entries are pruned on write; the file is capped at [jev.routing].cache_max_entries (default 500) by dropping the oldest. Concurrent classify() calls for different tasks never evict each other. Test: test_cache_holds_entries_per_key_for_interleaved_tasks (task A miss, task B miss, task A hit, task B hit: exactly two jev.ask calls), test_cache_prunes_expired_and_caps_entries.
2. .orchestrator/pool.toml: move the [jev.routing] table (with its comments) directly after the [jev] table and before any [secrets.*] table; values unchanged (mode = "shadow", cache_ttl_s = 86400) plus cache_max_entries = 500. Test: test_pool_toml_jev_routing_table_follows_jev (parse the file, assert key order or a simple line-index check).
Keep every T-0471 test and existing tests green; full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exit 0; commit in your worktree with the task id including every named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: route_cache.json is a per-key dict with TTL and a size cap; [jev.routing] sits directly after [jev] in pool.toml with cache_max_entries = 500
all T-0471 tests and existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree; the commit is on this task's own branch
